from fractions import Fraction as F

bps = [-23, 5, 48]
def g(x):
    x = F(x)
    return abs(x+23) + abs(x-5) + abs(x-48) - 2*x

def count(k):
    k = F(k)
    pts = [F(b) for b in bps]
    sols = set()
    # segments: (-inf,b0], [b0,b1], [b1,b2], [b2,inf)
    # use two sample points per piece to get the line exactly
    edges = [pts[0]-10] + pts + [pts[-1]+10]
    for i in range(len(edges)-1):
        a, b = edges[i], edges[i+1]
        ga, gb = g(a), g(b)
        m = (gb-ga)/(b-a)
        c = ga - m*a
        lo = None if i == 0 else edges[i]
        hi = None if i == len(edges)-2 else edges[i+1]
        # for outer rays, lines extend; use edges nearer breakpoints
        if i == 0:
            lo, hi = None, pts[0]
        elif i == len(edges)-2:
            lo, hi = pts[-1], None
        if m == 0:
            if c == k:
                sols.add(("interval", i))
            continue
        x = (k-c)/m
        if (lo is None or x >= lo) and (hi is None or x <= hi):
            sols.add(x)
    return len(sols)

cands = sorted(set(g(b) for b in bps))
print("g at breakpoints:", [(b, g(b)) for b in bps])
good = [k for k in cands if count(k) == 1]
print("candidate k with exactly one solution:", good)
